_about: Who the Buffer announcement credits, and where it posts.
All three networks take a plain '@...' in the post text and Buffer resolves it
at publish time: linkedin_name is the display name LinkedIn shows, x_handle and
threads_handle are the X and Threads handles without the '@'. A null handle
credits that party in plain text on that network.
LinkedIn only resolves a profile mention for one of the author's connections.
The author is never tagged: Buffer cannot tag the profile that owns the channel.
buffer_channels are Buffer channel ids; the pipeline posts to exactly these, and
stops before any upload unless the linkedin, twitter and threads ones are all
linkedin_credit, when set, is the literal LinkedIn text used instead of the
@mention. The company sets it to its Page URL: Buffer does not resolve an
@mention of a LinkedIn company Page, which would publish as literal text.
author: Andrey Devyatkin
